items.title: Google's AI Mode is citing Google more than any other site: Study
items.summary: Nearly one in five sources in Google's AI answers now comes from Google itself, with many citations leading to more Google Search results. This self-referencing trend has grown significantly, impacting how external content is featured in AI responses. Marketers and SEOs should monitor this shift as it influences visibility strategies.

items.title: Google's Liz Reid: Search and Gemini may converge, or diverge
items.summary: Google's search chief Liz Reid explores whether traditional search and AI models like Gemini will integrate or develop separately. Emerging AI agents and web behaviors are blurring lines between discovery tools and assistants. This uncertainty calls for flexible SEO approaches adapting to potential futures.

items.title: Authors Guild Expands ‘Human Authored’ Certification Program
items.summary: The Authors Guild has expanded its beta-launched certification program, initially for members in January 2025, to all U.S. authors and publishers, allowing them to certify books as human-authored rather than AI-generated with a trademarked seal. The program, which permits AI use for tools like spelling and grammar but not core text generation, has certified over 5,000 titles by more than 3,000 authors and includes a public database for verification. Publishers can now purchase certifications in bulk, addressing the rise of AI-generated content by providing a visible marker of human creativity on covers, copyright pages, and marketing materials.

items.title: Bookwire, ElevenLabs Team on AI Audiobook Production
items.summary: Bookwire, a Frankfurt-based e-book and audiobook distribution company, has partnered with London's ElevenLabs to provide AI-powered audiobook production to its clients, aiming to convert e-books that lack audiobook equivalents. This collaboration builds on Bookwire's existing WAY service, which produces around 500 audiobooks annually and serves over 3,500 publishers with more than 1.5 million e-books and 300,000 audiobooks distributed. The partnership seeks to expand the audiobook catalog available on ElevenLabs' platform, which caters to self-published authors and smaller publishers.

items.title: PMJ signs multi-book deal with formerly self-published author Lucinda Berry
items.summary: Pan Macmillan Japan (PMJ) has signed a multi-book deal with US author Lucinda Berry, who was previously self-published and has sold millions of copies. The deal covers world rights to two psychological thrillers, acquired by PMJ editor Yoko Tase from agent Dan Mandel at Sanford J. Greenburger Associates. This marks a significant transition for Berry from indie to traditional international publishing.

items.title: Traditional Deals for Self-Pub Authors Grew Significantly in 2025
items.summary: In 2025, the number of traditional publishing deals for self-published authors increased substantially, with more publishers competing for successful indie author series. These deals often include multi-book contracts valued in the six figures. This trend highlights growing opportunities for indie authors to transition into traditional publishing.

items.title: Religion Book Deals: Feb. 18, 2026
items.summary: Tyndale House secured a multi-book deal with speaker Asheritah Ciuciu including trade books, Bible studies, devotional, and middle grade fiction series focused on faith and womanhood. Other deals include InterVarsity Press acquiring books on women in Mosaic Law and WaterBrook's title on dying to self for freedom. These contracts emphasize traditional Christian narratives on spirituality, parenting, and theology.

items.title: Publishing Packages for Conservative Authors
items.summary: Liberty Hill Publishing offers tailored book publishing packages for conservative authors and writers. The services are designed to meet specific needs in the conservative publishing space. This initiative supports traditional messaging in nonfiction and other genres.

items.title: Michael B. Jordan Wins Best Actor for 'Sinners' at 2026 Actor Awards
items.summary: On March 1, 2026, at the 32nd annual Actor Awards in Los Angeles, Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for his portrayal of twins in Ryan Coogler's 'Sinners'. He hugged his mother onstage, honored his SAG-AFTRA roots, and credited her support from New Jersey. The victory boosts the film's Oscar prospects after multiple nominations.

items.title: Michael J. Fox Receives Sustained Ovation for Emotional Actor Awards Speech
items.summary: During the 2026 Actor Awards on March 1, Michael J. Fox gave an emotional speech honoring his family and career amid his Parkinson's battle, receiving a 15-second standing ovation. He shared humorous stories from 'Family Ties' and meeting his wife Tracy Pollan. Peers applauded warmly as cameras captured his peace sign.

items.title: 'Sinners' Ensemble Wins at Actor Awards with Delroy Lindo's Emotional Speech
items.summary: The cast of 'Sinners', including Delroy Lindo, won Best Ensemble at the 2026 Actor Awards on March 1, marking the film's first major precursor award. Lindo delivered a moving acceptance speech highlighting the group's achievement. The film leads in nominations and eyes Oscars after Producers Guild success.

items.title: Cillian Murphy Warns Against Preachy Films in Peaky Blinders Movie Discussion
items.summary: In a March 4, 2026, Telegraph interview, Cillian Murphy addressed the WWII-set Peaky Blinders film 'The Immortal Man', insisting it avoids being preachy or dogmatic about Nazis. He stated films should ask questions, not dictate feelings, positioning it as entertaining yet provocative action. Murphy contrasted it with 'Oppenheimer' amid real-world concerns.

items.title: Pixar's 'Hoppers' Projects $40M+ Box Office Opening Weekend
items.summary: Pixar's original animated film 'Hoppers' earned $3.2M in previews and is forecasting a $40M-plus domestic opening over the March 6-8 weekend. The strong start signals a win for Pixar's non-sequel efforts amid family audiences. It leads over 'The Bride!' in early box office reports.

items.title: Timothée Chalamet's Flashy Oscar Campaign Draws Voter Irritation
items.summary: Timothée Chalamet's unconventional push for 'Marty Supreme' Best Actor Oscar, including podcasts, blimps, and basketball, has irked some voters calling it annoying swagger. Despite Golden Globe and Critics' Choice wins, he lost the Actor Award to Michael B. Jordan on March 1. The A24 hit grossed $173M worldwide with nine Oscar nods.

items.title: VistaPrint Launches Generative AI Logomaker for Small Businesses
items.summary: VistaPrint has launched AI Logomaker by VistaPrint, a generative AI tool specifically designed for small businesses to create personalized, high-quality, print-ready logos in minutes. It bypasses generic templates and complex prompts, requiring no design skills or large budgets, and provides free digital and scalable files. This product empowers entrepreneurs to build professional brands affordably and quickly.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">22</argument></grok:render><grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">25</argument></grok:render>

items.title: Launch Commerce Rebrands and Unveils AI-Powered Business Platform for Small Businesses
items.summary: Launch Commerce, previously Launch Cart, rebranded and rolled out a unified AI-powered platform that integrates seven products to automate operations, capture leads, and drive revenue for small and mid-sized businesses. The system offers a single login and subscription, using AI to improve response times and help operators compete effectively. It's aimed at businesses juggling multiple tools and missing opportunities.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">20</argument></grok:render>

items.title: Intuit Launches AI-Powered Construction Edition ERP for Small to Mid-Market Businesses
items.summary: Intuit introduced the Construction Edition for its Enterprise Suite, an AI-native ERP solution tailored for mid-market construction firms to unify project, financial, and operational workflows. Features include AI-driven cost proposals, invoicing, budgeting, and real-time KPI dashboards to tackle job complexity and cash flow issues. This marks Intuit's first industry-specific ERP push.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">24</argument></grok:render>

items.title: Amazon Introduces AI Canvas for Sellers to Visualize and Grow Businesses in Real Time
items.summary: Amazon launched a new AI-powered canvas experience in Seller Central, integrating chat with dynamic visuals for instant personalized insights, recommendations, and scenario testing. This agentic AI evolves the Seller Assistant to help sellers launch, manage, and scale operations faster, cutting data analysis time dramatically. It's available free to U.S. and U.K. sellers.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">23</argument></grok:render>

items.title: Rowan Launches AI-Powered Platform Addressing Small Business Succession Crisis
items.summary: Rowan publicly launched an AI-driven succession platform for small businesses, using proprietary tech and expert guidance to prepare owners for transitions and connect with buyers. It captures critical knowledge to enable smooth handovers amid projections of 6 million business changes by 2035. The tool aims to solve the challenge where essential know-how resides only in owners' heads.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">26</argument></grok:render>
